transcript.text: Thanks everyone for joining. As you all know, the shared #launch-room channel was paused after the recurring public disagreements during our last product launch, and that's pushed our launch coordination into scattered email threads — which isn't sustainable. Both squads still need a common place for launch updates, questions, and decisions. Before I make a decision on whether and how to reopen the channel, I want to follow our standard process: I need each affected squad representative, an affected contributor, and Employee Relations to place your relevant observations, existing commitments, accommodations, and policy requirements into the formal input record. Once I have that input, I'll settle the operating arrangement for the channel. Let's go ahead and get started.
